newsitem.title: JAPAN: Forex to stabilise soon - Japan gov't spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Forex to stabilise soon - Japan gov't spokesman.

text.p: The foreign exchange market is likely to stabilise soon, as the Group of Seven (G7) agreement last month is becoming accepted by the market, Japan's chief government spokesman Seiroku Kajiyama told a news conference on Monday.
Kajiyama said that, in any event, the government would keep a close watch on foreign exchange market moves.
"(The recent moves in the market) indicate that the G7 agreement is gradually being accepted in the market," Kajiyama said.
"In any event, we (the government) will keep a close eye on foreign exchange movements," he added.
